lines.text: This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.

data.define: Short for legitimate; used for things that are real, true or really good.

example.text: This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.

misuse.text: Don't say 'legit' in a legal document.

data.l1_ex: Shop này legit nha, chị tui mua giày ở đó.

native.tip: “legit” = Xịn thật, đáng tin. Ví dụ: “This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.”
native.caption:
“legit” nghĩa là gì?
“legit” = Xịn thật, đáng tin.
Ví dụ: “This shop is legit, my sister bought shoes there.” (Shop này legit nha, chị tui mua giày ở đó.)
